inventory_method: Recursive filesystem walk, including hidden/ignored project Markdown; excludes dependency/cache trees .git,node_modules,.venv,venv,__pycache__,.pytest_cache,.ruff_cache. Five added ignored files are vendor LiveKit documentation.
provenance: Initial hashes are pre-edit read source. Current hashes record planned primary-document/workboard edits. New assessment outputs are reviewed separately, not retroactively inserted into the initial corpus. A document may contain mixed historical claims; full reading does not make every claim current or proven.

reading_coverage.method: Every unique table cell shown to model without truncation, first-occurrence order. Exact cell text deduplicated after removing Markdown margin whitespace only. Every original table row is mapped to ordered cell IDs below; source hash and character offsets bind the mapping. All non-table text model-visible: initial character range [0,22000), then every remaining non-table line individually. This is content reading through deduplication, not only structural parsing and not a claim every repeated cell was separately reread.

classificeert ieder gevolgd, verwijderd of niet-genegeerd nieuw repositorypad.
De randdetectie is begrensd tot letterlijke lokale imports, package-scripts en testglobs,
spawnpaden, systemd Exec/Unit/OnFailure, installerbestandsnamen en browserloads.
Afwezigheid van een heuristische rand is geen bewijs dat een extern systeem geen caller heeft.
